code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There are also abnormalities in white cell differential (low neutrophils and lymphocytes, high monocytes and basophils), and mild anisocytosis. These findings may indicate acute infection, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired renal function. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
